records.question: How many customers signed up before 2024?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_signed_up FROM customers c WHERE c.signup_date < '2024-01-01'

records.question: What is the most expensive product?
records.generated_sql: SELECT p.product_name, MAX(p.price) AS max_price FROM products p GROUP BY p.product_name

records.question: How many products belong to the Home & Kitchen category?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE category_name = 'Home & Kitchen')

records.question: How many orders are there in total?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

records.question: How many customers live in Bengaluru?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_in_bengaluru FROM customers c WHERE c.city = 'Bengaluru'

records.question: What is the lowest stock quantity among all products?
records.generated_sql: SELECT MIN(stock_quantity) AS lowest_stock_quantity FROM products

records.question: How many orders were delivered in 2026?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01' AND status = 'delivered'

records.question: What is the average amount of paid card payments?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS average_card_payment FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' AND p.payment_method = 'card'

records.question: How many customers from Gujarat have placed at least one order?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers_from_gujarat FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.state = 'Gujarat'

records.question: What is the total amount of failed payments?
records.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_failed_payments FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'failed'

records.question: How many orders were placed in December 2025?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_placed_in_december_2025 FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-12-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

records.question: How many products cost more than 2000?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE price > 2000

records.question: How many payments were made via cash on delivery?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cash_on_delivery_payments FROM payments WHERE payment_method = 'cash_on_delivery'

records.question: What is the total revenue from paid card payments made in 2024?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_card_revenue FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' AND p.payment_method = 'card' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

records.question: How many customers placed more than 10 orders?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 10)

records.question: Which state has the highest revenue?
records.generated_sql: SELECT c.state, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many customers have had both a cancelled order and a delivered order?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('cancelled', 'delivered')
) t

records.question: Which payment method has the highest total paid amount?
records.generated_sql: SELECT pm.payment_method, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT payment_method FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC LIMIT 1) pm ON p.payment_method = pm.payment_method WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY pm.payment_method ORDER BY total_paid DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many customers have not placed any order in 2025?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_orders FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01')

records.question: What is the total revenue from Electronics products?
records.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = pr.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND cat.category_name = 'Electronics'
